== Hero Usage == 
* Heroes use this skill depending on their and their target's health:
** When above 50% health, use on targets below ~80% health.
** When below 50% health, use on targets below ~15% health.
** When at very low health, use on targets at very low health. This can cause the hero to kill itself.

== Notes == 
* While this skill typically deals more damage to the user than the target, there are multiple situations where this can be useful: 
** The short recharge time allows it to trigger [[Dark Aura]] frequently. This can become even more frequent if combining it with [[Masochism]]. 
** Dark Pact has an energy cost of just 1, making it a very cost-efficient choice for damage. This can be useful if the user has a surplus of health from the many life-stealing skills associated with Blood Magic.
